subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: After the four guard assertions are repaired and final-head checks are green, should maintainers approve these grouped action revisions across token, scanning, publishing, repository-automation, and Codex workflows?
rationale: Release identities and runtime compatibility are verified, but accepting replacement third-party executable code in privileged workflows requires explicit maintainer trust judgment.

options.title: Approve repaired final head
options.body: Accept the grouped update after synchronized assertions, green exact-head checks, and owner review of the verified revisions.

options.title: Split privileged families
options.body: Review token, CodeQL, Docker/release, repository automation, and Codex action updates in narrower pull requests.

options.title: Hold current revisions
options.body: Defer the group until owners have sufficient upstream and operational confidence.

recommendation.title: Approve repaired final head
recommendation.body: Accept the grouped update after synchronized assertions, green exact-head checks, and owner review of the verified revisions.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest cross-workflow history signal and can coordinate the security and release ownership boundaries.
